test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Article _______ of the Constitution which enshrines one of the Directive Principles of State Policy, lays down that the State shall take steps to organise village panchayats and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 40.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Article 40**

 
 
• **It is a part of the Indian Constitution's Directive Principles of State Policy.**
 
• It lays down that the government should** establish village panchayats and empower them for self-government.**
 
• It recognizes the importance of** Panchayat Raj Institutions as units of self-government.**
